acceptance_note: All correctness receipts required. No arbitrary minimum 3% gain cutoff. Representative rotating-frame micro support and no common-workload loss, all search-control grouped intervals positive, long-control order support, no >3% elapsed fixture median regression. No active promotion.
method: exp(mean(per-position median(log(paired wall-NPS ratio)))); 10,000-draw hierarchical bootstrap: resample positions as groups then paired repetitions within group; seed 20261017. Repetitions are not independent positions. No multiplicity or temporal-autocorrelation adjustment; these are fixture-suite speed intervals, not Elo or universal workload guarantees.
